postconditions.expression: tiles.isupper() and all(tile in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for tile in tiles)
postconditions.description: The input string tiles consists of uppercase English letters.
The length of the input string tiles is between 1 and 7, inclusive.
The function returns a number greater than or equal to 1, representing the number of possible non-empty sequences of letters that can be made using the letters printed on those tiles.
